reason: This plugin is primarily an external-service utility for DeepSeek Harness that surfaces provider health, quota, and account usage information in the Models settings while also generating local token-usage analytics for user-visible monitoring and planning. The evidence shows it performs provider API checks, reads credentials through the host credential service, and builds on local session data without adding external persistence features.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，在模型设置中提供提供商健康检查、额度/用量查询，并展示本地会话 token 使用统计与图表。
summaries.en: This plugin is for DeepSeek Harness, adding provider health checks, quota/account usage queries, and local token-usage dashboards in the model settings workflow.

capabilities: Makes HTTPS requests to provider endpoints for model health and usage checks
Reads provider credentials via DeepSeek Harness credential services
Calls provider usage APIs with provider-origin scoping
Processes and stores local token usage data and provider/account usage query results in plugin settings namespace
Renders local dashboard visualizations from session log data
